title: Repair an insertion sort
prompt: Sort values from smallest to largest, in place, and return the same array. Use insertion sort.
hints: In the failing check, which element never moves?
The inner loop must be allowed to compare with the element at index 0.
Change the inner condition from j > 0 to j >= 0.

rules.name: sort
rules.message: Write the sort yourself. Do not call sort.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Never compares with the first element, so it stays where it is.
Calls the built-in sort instead of practising the method.

feedback: Trace the inner loop for the pass that should move an element to the very front. Which value of j does it stop at?
